scenes.title: Reversal
scenes.summary: Reversal is a change to the opposite of what is being done: the messenger who comes to cheer Oedipus, the Lynceus.

scenes.title: Recognition
scenes.summary: Recognition is a change from ignorance to knowledge, best when it comes with reversal, as in the Oedipus; it may be of one person by the other, or mutual, like Iphigenia's and Orestes'.

scenes.title: Suffering
scenes.summary: The third part of the plot is suffering: a destructive or painful act, deaths in full view, agonies and wounds.
